note: App-published layout-3 job: 3 characters per US Letter page. `3 per page`, `layout three`, and `three Chinese characters on the page` are this job (jobs[].phrases), not a filename. Pass this file as the CLI argument (or --config); it is the configuration, not a character dataset. The workbench button label is "3 字/页". Equivalent to `npm run print:layout-3`, `npm run test:e2e layout 3`, one quoted argument `run the end-to-end test to generate the PDF, layout 3` (example.instructionArgv), or the absolute jobs[].argv / example.configArgv from --describe (works from any cwd). A quoted sentence may include --limit, --dry-run, cols, or 每行; those are options, not a filename, and Chinese wording such as 跑端到端测试生成 PDF，layout 3 is the same job. cols, rows, and trace are omitted so the workbench defaults apply (5 columns, 3 rows, 1 dashed trace row). printer/ paths resolve from the repo root. Add "limit": 24 to print only the first 24 characters. Do not pass --limit through npm. If npm consumes --dry-run, the CLI previews and does not write the PDF. `npm run test:e2e` with no layout is visual regression, not this job. The same words as separate argv are this job too: a comma stuck to PDF, or file, is glue, not a missing filename, and a comma stuck to printer/spec/data/hanzi-1000-v6.json, is that file. The bare names hanzi-1000-v6.json and print-job.example.json are these published files from any cwd; a same-named file in the cwd wins. spec/data/hanzi-1000-v6.json is the same dataset. Separate argv uses the same option words: layout 3 limit 6, cols 5, 3 字/页 每行 5, and 黑白省墨 are configuration, not a missing filename. Words after 3 字/页 stay that button label. The workbench 序号 picker is the same as --range: 序号 1-12, 选取 1-24, and 序号 1 - 12 are not a missing filename. The hyphen between those inputs is not an option. A bare 选取 does not change the selection. --no-mono and --no-footer-title are the workbench checkboxes as separate argv, not unknown options. --no-footer-title unchecks 页脚标题 (default on). --footer-title false, --footer-title=off, --mono=off, 页脚标题 off, showFooterTitle false, and setting-footer-title false uncheck the box. They are not a filename and do not leave the box checked. A bare false is still a filename. --footer-title=maybe is an error. Passing both forms conflicts. `chars per page 3`, `3 chars per page`, and `--chars per page 3` are this layout phrase (jobs[].phrases), not a --chars filter and not a file named page. `--chars 一,二` still selects those characters. `chars per` without page is still the filter. `3个字/页` and the workbench aria-label `每页字数 3` are this layout phrase (jobs[].phrases), not a missing filename. `每页字数` with no count is an incomplete layout, not a second job. A verb before a workbench checkbox is that checkbox, not a filename and not a checked box: `关闭 页脚标题`, `关闭页脚标题`, `不显示 页脚标题`, `uncheck 页脚标题`, and `turn off 页脚标题` uncheck 页脚标题. `开启 黑白省墨` and `打开 黑白省墨` check 黑白省墨. The workbench title is that label when a verb precedes it (`关闭 在页脚显示字库标题`). A bare `关闭` is still a filename. `关闭 页脚标题 true` conflicts. `把 页脚标题 关闭`, `把页脚标题关闭`, `将 黑白省墨 打开`, and `turn 页脚标题 off` put the verb after the label. They are that checkbox, not a file named 把. `把 页脚标题` without a verb still leaves 把 as a filename. `页脚标题关闭`, `页脚标题 关掉`, and `页脚标题off` are that checkbox with no 把.
